Pay It Phorward

O3 World’s CEO, Keith Scandone, along with David M. Davis, managing director for Accenture’s Public Sector, have launched Pay It Phorward, a peer-to-peer grant program that aims to help individuals and businesses in Philadelphia impacted by COVID-19.

Keith chatted recently with Technical.ly’s Paige Gross about the Pay It Phorward program, as well as other ways our team is aiming to support the Philadelphia community during these uncertain times.
